mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact fixed-source static matrix inverse/KKT derivative identities, five two-component examples including actual retained Phi/X background, 15 finite positive-wavenumber checks, and sharp finite-band endpoint relative-error algebra.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SymPy rational and algebraic exact matrices; reported summaries converted to binary64
mathematics.conventions: z=k^2>0, canonical static K=A+zB, B positive semidefinite; fixed density vector q, optional nonnegative constant susceptibility; h=1/chi is inverse density response. Newtonian K_g=4piG>0. Actual point is NR retained-source RWA, before separately documented threshold correction.
non_claims: No claim that finite examples prove the universal monotonicity argument.
No all-loop/all-phase no-go: momentum-dependent source, nonlocal kernel, flowing/inhomogeneous medium or new constraint field can change the hypotheses.
No physical rational law, critical normalization, vacuum acceleration or halo calculation.
